privacy.title: Privacy
items: What we collect: the display name you choose, your message, and your email address if you give it. We ask for nothing else.
Why: to review and answer your message. Comments and questions, and ideas you allow us to share, are published with your display name only after review. Private consultations are never published.
Your email address is never published. We use it only to answer you.
Ratings are anonymous. To allow one rating per project and to stop spam, we keep a one-way coded form of your internet address, never the address itself.
Where: the data is stored with Supabase in Frankfurt, Germany (European Union).
To ask us to remove something you sent, write to us through the private consultation form.

edit.firstContent: Content editing: sign in with a GitHub access token.
firstContentSteps: On github.com, open Settings → Developer settings → Personal access tokens → Fine-grained tokens → Generate new token.
Repository access: only the bubapix repository. Permissions: Contents — Read and write; Pull requests — Read and write.
Copy the token. In content editing choose “Sign In Using Access Token” and paste it. Do this only on your own site, never on a shared preview address.
edit.firstComments: Comments and messages: sign in with email and password.
firstCommentsSteps: On supabase.com open the BubaPix project → Authentication → Users → Add user → Create new user.
Email: moshiko259@gmail.com. Choose a password and keep it to yourself. Tick “Auto Confirm User”.
Open “Comments and messages” and sign in with that email and password.
edit.previewNote: On the preview address the buttons open the editing screens, but signing in works only on your own site after it is published.

app.iosTitle: Add BubaPix to your home screen
iosSteps: In Safari, tap the Share button (a square with an arrow pointing up).
Scroll down and tap “Add to Home Screen”.
Tap “Add”. The BubaPix icon appears on your home screen.
